pattern.description: Notion AI's generated paragraph grows line by line under the selected bullets, pushing the page up each time a line lands; when generation finishes the send button greys out, an Accept / Discard / Insert below menu appears under the prompt bar and the cursor moves to Accept.
pattern.why_premium: Real generation cadence is kept (discrete line drops with the page reflowing) so the AI feels live, and the cursor arriving on Accept right as the menu appears sets up the next beat without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.answer .line', {autoAlpha: 1, stagger: 0.1}).to('.doc', {y: '-=37', duration: 0.1, ease: 'none', stagger: 0.1}, '<') then .to('.send', {backgroundColor: '#c8c8c8', duration: 0.08}).fromTo('.ai-menu', {autoAlpha: 0, y: -4}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out'}).to('.cursor', {x: ax, y: ay, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '<')
build_hint.remotion: Line i visible when frame >= lineStart[i]; doc translateY = -lineHeight * linesShown (stepped, no spring); menu opacity = interpolate(frame, [m, m+3], [0,1]); cursor via interpolate with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad).

notes: Filmstrip frames are cropped and repeated (f700, f706 x3), so exact line-arrival order is inferred. The page shift is content reflow inside the window (camera move none), modelled as stepped slide_up of b02/b07. Menu items listed separately because no candidate box covers the whole menu.
